SELECT count(*) inventory_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE x->>'currentness_source'='LIVE_PG_PROC') source_labeled_live,count(*) FILTER(WHERE x->>'definition_md5' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$') format_valid FROM public.lf_eventos e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x WHERE e.id=20161

sql_evidence.sql_literal: WITH t AS(SELECT (SELECT created_at FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161) inventory_time,(SELECT created_at FROM programacion.provenance_receipts WHERE id=38) soak_time,(SELECT max(primera_vez) FROM transversal.error_knowledge WHERE codigo IN('IG-M107-SOAK-CRITERION-DRIFT-001','IG-M107-CP2-READ-ROLE-CURRENTNESS-001')) ekb_last_time) SELECT inventory_time,soak_time,ekb_last_time, inventory_time < soak_time source_before_receipt, soak_time < ekb_last_time receipt_before_ekb, ekb_last_time<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-15T00:00:00Z' all_pre_cutoff FROM t

SELECT payload->'usage_stats' usage_stats,payload->'deduplication' dedup,payload->'excluded_name_candidate' excluded,payload->'historical_provenance_only' provenance FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161

usage_stats.interpretation: track_functions none means zero stat rows cannot prove no usage; static governed graph supplies inventory currentness

dedup.rule: One logical caller identity per source URI/object identity; evidence from multiple governed sources is merged instead of double-counted.
dedup.profiles_edge_identity: EDGE_FN_LF_PROFILES_GOVERNANCE_CALLER_V1 maps to live Edge lf-profiles-governance-caller-v1.

excluded.reason: Current caller.ts invokes configured LF_PROFILE_CREATOR_RUNTIME_SLUG/default run-creacion-perfil-lf and contains no IG call; name/existence is not usage evidence.

provenance.router_note: Router binding snapshot observes readiness revision 5.12 while governed current readiness snapshot is 5.13; retained as provenance/currentness drift only.
provenance.contract_note: Older input contract rows remain recorded; caller usage is not inferred from their existence.

findings.claim: The P0 packet joins three pre-cutoff evidence times: caller inventory earlier than verified SOAK receipt, which precedes last EKB finding. Same P0 cutoff does not mean same observation timestamp.
The 38 labels LIVE_PG_PROC are historical labels at source-event time, not current qualified observations; this naming can create false confidence in live topology
Source-pack acceptance_declared false, runtime_activation false and no production change. No basis to infer a completed operational remediation.
Existing verified receipt and missing perf telemetry can coexist; neither disproves the other, so a single status field would erase distinctions

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: Status confusion caused by joining historical event, later SOAK receipt and still later EKB warning into one undifferentiated CURRENT flag
causal_hypotheses.falsifier: Materialize source/time/role identity for every claim and test claim reversal when one source is withdrawn

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: Cost pressure from repeated independent SQL reads across roles, despite overlapping source event
causal_hypotheses.falsifier: Instrument transport/execution per query and compare source-once memoized variables to independent live reads, keeping different freshness needs isolated

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: No product defect in tested path; only evidence currentness/read privilege mismatch
causal_hypotheses.falsifier: Authorized same-time functional CP2 trace vs permission code

unresolved: Cannot prove no defect or a causal defect

novel_safe_design.idea: Version-stamped read-once evidence graph, with per-claim source timestamp and invalidation, not forced CURRENT flags
novel_safe_design.risk: Cross-time reuse without qualification would worsen currentness
novel_safe_design.test: Discriminating allowed reads under same temporal/evidence contracts

next_safe_step: Verify each P0 claim's temporal provenance and allow null/unknown before any repair; measure read-once transport objectively
